storyCards.headline: Annie's Song: The Breakthrough Moment
storyCards.fact:
John Denver's "Annie's Song" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Annie's Song" (also known as "Annie's Song (You Fill Up My Senses)") is a song written and recorded by American singer-songwriter John Denver.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 17 weeks on the chart.

Graph compilation anchor: "John Denver's Greatest Hits, Volume 2" (1977) — not the song's original release year.

Album: John Denver's Greatest Hits, Volume 2 (1977).

Chart story — peaked at #1 on the Hot 100.
